title: Action Rowdy
desc: Anna rules over Rayalaseema with a good heart. However, when a project threatens the well-being of his people, he does everything he can to oppose it and angers dangerous people as a result.

title: Hit List
desc: A mysterious masked figure kidnaps the family of a peaceful man, forcing him into a life of violence. He becomes an unwilling assassin, targeting the kidnapper's enemies as a part of his revenge plan.

title: Shoorveer
desc: Siddharth, a fashion editor who hates horses, decides to venture into the world of horse racing to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Sabdham
desc: A paranormal investigator tackles mysterious university deaths. As evidence mounts, they question their beliefs and confront a possible supernatural threat.

title: Rathnam
desc: Rathnam, a henchman for MLA Panner Selvam, rescues a girl from attackers during her interview trip to Vellore. As he becomes her protector, he wonders how long he can keep her safe.
